summary.text: Ryan Fountain is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Rick Jasperse.
An information technology professional, he says in a Ballotpedia survey that he was born and raised in Ball Ground, Georgia.

paragraphs.text: Fountain earned a high school diploma from Creekview High School, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his career experience as an information technology professional.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in a household led by a single mother of four and, as the oldest child, looked after his siblings.
Fountain advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.

His survey answers listed infrastructure, including water systems in Jasper and Pickens counties, and education as key messages, and he proposed a Georgia Achievement Fund that would create merit-based investment accounts for public school students starting in sixth grade.
